```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, dpi = 110)

library(ggplot2)
# plot_var() returns a patchwork object as soon as strata are involved, so
# the package has to be attached for those plots to print.
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) library(patchwork)

meta     <- params$meta
imp      <- params$import
setu     <- params$setup
energy   <- params$energy
outlier  <- params$outlier
samp     <- params$sampling
opts     <- params$opts

# ---- small local helpers (kept here so the template is self-contained) ----
`%|%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a)) ||
                            (is.character(a) && !any(nzchar(a)))) b else a

kt <- function(x, ...) {
    if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    knitr::kable(x, format = "html", escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, ...)
}

pill_html <- function(text, level = "neutral") {
    sprintf('<span class="vcg-pill pill-%s">%s</span>', level, text)
}

tile_html <- function(label, value, sub = "") {
    sprintf(paste0('<div class="vcg-tile"><div class="vcg-tile-label">%s</div>',
                   '<div class="vcg-tile-value">%s</div>',
                   '<div class="vcg-tile-sub">%s</div></div>'),
            label, value, sub)
}

tiles_html <- function(...) {
    cat('<div class="vcg-tiles">', paste0(c(...), collapse = ""), '</div>', sep = "\n")
}

status_pill <- function(status) {
    lvl <- switch(status,
                  "ok" = "ok",
                  "size >= 75% of POOL" = "warn",
                  "very small POOL" = "warn",
                  "bad")
    pill_html(status, lvl)
}

verdict <- function(p, phase, alpha = 0.05) {
    if (is.null(p) || is.na(p)) return(pill_html("not available", "neutral"))
    if (phase == "before") {
        if (p < alpha) pill_html("POOL and TG differ - balancing is worthwhile", "warn")
        else           pill_html("no detectable imbalance to start with", "ok")
    } else {
        if (p < alpha) pill_html("VCG still differs from TG - balancing did not succeed", "bad")
        else           pill_html("VCG matches TG - balancing successful", "ok")
    }
}
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
logo <- meta$logo
img_tag <- ""
if (!is.null(logo) && file.exists(logo)) {
    img_tag <- sprintf('<img src="%s" alt="VCG sampler">', knitr::image_uri(logo))
}
cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="vcg-report-header">%s<p class="vcg-report-date">eVCGsampler app v%s<br>eVCGsampler v%s</p></div>',
    img_tag, meta$app_version, meta$pkg_version
))

# Study and author on their own lines - two consecutive inline expressions
# in markdown would be folded into a single paragraph.
if (nzchar(meta$study  %|% "")) cat("**Study:** ",       meta$study,  "  \n", sep = "")
if (nzchar(meta$author %|% "")) cat("**Prepared by:** ", meta$author, "  \n", sep = "")
```

This report documents a Virtual Control Group (VCG) drawn with energy-distance based
covariate balancing. The sampler selects **whole, unweighted animals** from the
historical control pool, so no special downstream analysis is required.

Balancing is a final refinement step. It reduces biological heterogeneity, but it
does not replace careful pre-filtering of the historical control data and it does
not address technical heterogeneity from differing collection methods, processing
pipelines or experimental conditions.

```{r comment, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(meta$comment %|% "")) {
    cat('<div class="vcg-note">', htmltools::htmlEscape(meta$comment), '</div>', sep = "\n")
}
```

# 1. Data import

```{r import-tiles, results='asis'}
tiles_html(
    tile_html("POOL file", format(meta$n_pool_file %|% "-", big.mark = " "),
              meta$pool_name %|% "-"),
    tile_html("TG file",
              if (isTRUE(meta$combined)) format(meta$n_tg_file %|% "-", big.mark = " ") else "-",
              if (isTRUE(meta$combined)) (meta$tg_name %|% "-") else "included in the POOL file"),
    tile_html("Rows for balancing", format(imp$n_rows, big.mark = " "), "after combining"),
    tile_html("Variables", imp$n_vars, "columns available")
)
```

```{r import-mode, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(meta$combined)) {
    cat("The POOL and the TG animals were uploaded separately and stacked with",
        "`combine_data()`, which keeps only the variables present in **both** files",
        "and adds the group indicator `", setu$group, "`.\n", sep = " ")
} else {
    cat("A single file was uploaded; the group variable `", setu$group,
        "` was already part of it.\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r combine-check, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(imp$check)) {
    cat("\n## Variable matching between the two files\n\n")
    n_drop <- sum(imp$check$Status == "dropped")
    n_bad  <- sum(imp$check$Status == "type mismatch")
    n_keep <- sum(imp$check$Status == "combined")
    cat(paste(pill_html(paste0(n_keep, " combined"), if (n_keep > 0) "ok" else "bad"),
              if (n_drop > 0) pill_html(paste0(n_drop, " dropped"), "warn") else "",
              if (n_bad  > 0) pill_html(paste0(n_bad, " type mismatch"), "bad") else ""),
        "\n\n")
    print(kt(imp$check))
}
```

# 2. Setup

```{r setup-formula, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="vcg-formula">', setu$formula, '</div>', sep = "")
```

* **Animal ID:** `r if (is.null(setu$id)) "none selected" else setu$id`
* **Group variable:** `r setu$group`
* **Covariates balanced:** `r paste(setu$covariates, collapse = ", ")`
* **Stratum variables:** `r if (length(setu$stratum)) paste(setu$stratum, collapse = ", ") else "none"`
* **VCG size:** `r paste(setu$sizes, collapse = ", ")`
* **Covariate weights:** `r if (is.null(setu$weights)) "none (all covariates weighted equally)" else paste(paste0(setu$covariates, " x", setu$weights), collapse = ", ")`
* **Complete cases used:** `r format(setu$n_complete, big.mark = " ")` of `r format(imp$n_rows, big.mark = " ")` rows

## Sample sizes

```{r size-overview, results='asis'}
ov <- setu$overview
if (!is.null(ov)) {
    show <- ov
    show$Share_of_POOL <- ifelse(is.na(show$Share_of_POOL), "-", paste0(show$Share_of_POOL, "%"))
    show$VCG_size <- ifelse(is.na(show$VCG_size), "-", as.character(show$VCG_size))
    show$Status <- vapply(ov$Status, status_pill, character(1))
    names(show) <- c("Stratum", "N POOL", "N TG", "VCG size", "Share of POOL", "Status")
    print(kt(show))
}
if (length(setu$messages)) {
    for (m in setu$messages) cat('<div class="vcg-note">', m, '</div>\n', sep = "")
}
```

# 3. Pre-tests

## Energy test - POOL vs TG

```{r energy, results='asis'}
if (is.null(energy)) {
    cat("_The energy test was not run._\n")
} else {
    tiles_html(
        tile_html("Energy distance", signif(energy$distance, 4), "0 = identical distributions"),
        tile_html("p-value", if (is.na(energy$p_value)) "-" else signif(energy$p_value, 3),
                  if (isTRUE(energy$stratified)) "smallest across strata" else "one-sided permutation test"),
        tile_html("Permutations", energy$R, "per test"),
        tile_html("Alpha", energy$alpha, "significance level")
    )
    cat("\n", verdict(energy$p_value, "before", energy$alpha), "\n\n")
    cat("A small p-value means the POOL and the TG differ more than random variation",
        "would explain - which is the situation VCG sampling is designed for.\n\n")
    print(kt(energy$table))
    if (isTRUE(energy$stratified)) {
        cat("\n**Energy distance per stratum**\n\n")
        print(kt(energy$per_stratum))
    }
}
```

```{r energy-plot, fig.height=4.6}
if (!is.null(energy) && isFALSE(energy$stratified) && !is.null(energy$plot)) {
    energy$plot
}
```

```{r energy-plot-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(energy) && isFALSE(energy$stratified)) {
    cat("_Purple: energy distances from randomly reshuffled group labels.",
        "Orange: the critical value. Cyan: the observed distance._\n")
}
```

## Outlier studies

```{r outlier, results='asis'}
if (is.null(outlier)) {
    cat("_The outlier study test was not run._\n")
} else {
    n_out <- sum(outlier$summary$is_outlier)
    cat(pill_html(paste0(n_out, if (n_out == 1) " outlier study" else " outlier studies"),
                  if (n_out == 0) "ok" else "warn"), "\n\n")
    cat(nrow(outlier$summary), " studies of `", outlier$study, "` were compared on ",
        paste(outlier$vars, collapse = ", "), " (", format(outlier$n_used, big.mark = " "),
        " animals", if (isTRUE(outlier$pool_only)) ", POOL only" else "", "). ",
        "Studies beyond the ", round(100 * outlier$cutoff),
        "th percentile of the permuted distances are flagged.\n\n", sep = "")
    s <- outlier$summary
    show <- data.frame(
        Study = s$group,
        `Median energy distance` = signif(s$median_distance, 4),
        Verdict = vapply(s$is_outlier, function(o)
            pill_html(if (isTRUE(o)) "outlier" else "consistent",
                      if (isTRUE(o)) "bad" else "ok"), character(1)),
        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    print(kt(show))
    if (n_out > 0) {
        cat('<div class="vcg-note">Consider whether the flagged studies belong in the',
            'historical control pool at all. This test looks at outcome and technical',
            'variables, not at the balanced covariates.</div>\n')
    }
}
```

# 4. VCG sampling

```{r sampling-tiles, results='asis'}
multi <- isTRUE(samp$multi)
if (multi) {
    vcols  <- grep("^VCG_[0-9]+$", names(samp$data), value = TRUE)
    n_each <- sum(samp$data[[vcols[1]]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_ok   <- sum(!is.na(samp$post_ps) & samp$post_ps >= 0.05)
    tiles_html(
        tile_html("VCGs drawn", samp$n_vcg, paste(n_each, "animals each")),
        tile_html("Balanced VCGs", paste0(n_ok, " / ", samp$n_vcg), "post-hoc p &ge; 0.05"),
        tile_html("Smallest p-value",
                  if (is.na(samp$post_p)) "-" else signif(samp$post_p, 3), "across all VCGs"),
        tile_html("Overlap", if (is.na(samp$overlap_pct)) "-" else paste0(samp$overlap_pct, "%"),
                  paste0("seed ", samp$seed)),
        tile_html("Permutations", samp$R, "post-hoc test per VCG")
    )
    cat("\n", samp$n_vcg, " random VCGs were drawn with `multiSampler()`. They are meant",
        " to be used as a set, e.g. for a proof-of-concept study, not for picking the",
        " best-looking VCG afterwards.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
n_vcg <- sum(!is.na(samp$data$VCG) & samp$data$VCG == 1)
tiles_html(
    tile_html("VCG selected", n_vcg, "animals"),
    tile_html("Post-hoc p-value",
              if (is.na(samp$post_p)) "-" else signif(samp$post_p, 3),
              if (isTRUE(samp$stratified)) "smallest across strata" else "TG vs VCG"),
    tile_html("Mode", if (isTRUE(samp$random)) "random subset" else "best subset",
              paste0("seed ", samp$seed)),
    tile_html("Permutations", samp$R, "post-hoc test")
)
cat("\n", verdict(samp$post_p, "after"), "\n\n")
cat("A **large** p-value is the goal here: it means the selected VCG is no longer",
    "distinguishable from the TG on the balanced covariates.\n\n")
}
if (length(samp$notes)) {
    for (m in unique(samp$notes)) cat('<div class="vcg-note">', m, '</div>\n', sep = "")
}
```

```{r balance-plot-height, include=FALSE}
# The overlap plot draws one bar per POOL animal.
overlap_h <- 6
if (multi) {
    pool <- samp$data[!is.na(samp$data[[vcols[1]]]), , drop = FALSE]
    n_pool <- if ("in_stratum" %in% names(pool)) max(table(pool$in_stratum)) else nrow(pool)
    overlap_h <- max(5, min(20, n_pool / 12))
}
```

```{r balance-plot, results='asis', fig.height=overlap_h}
if (multi) {
    cat("\n## VCG overlap\n\n")
    cat("_How often each POOL animal was drawn across the VCGs. The overlap is the",
        "mean share of VCGs an animal is in, among the animals drawn at least once._\n\n")
    for (k in seq_along(samp$overlap)) {
        if (!is.null(names(samp$overlap))) cat("\n### Stratum", names(samp$overlap)[k], "\n\n")
        print(samp$overlap[[k]])
        cat("\n\n")
    }
} else {
    cat("\n## Balance target plot\n\n")
    print(samp$plot)
    cat("\n\n_Each arrow starts at the POOL-vs-TG difference and points at the VCG-vs-TG",
        "difference, in median (x) and MAD (y). The purple ellipse is the 95% range of",
        "differences under random permutation, so an arrow tip inside it means the",
        "remaining difference is ordinary noise._\n\n")
}
```

## Median (MAD) per group

```{r median-mad}
kt(samp$summary)
```

`POOL` is the whole historical control pool, `VCG` the subset that was selected
(`VCG_1`, `VCG_2`, ... when several VCGs were drawn). The VCG rows should sit
closer to `TG` than `POOL` does.

```{r cov-plot-height, include=FALSE}
# plot_var() stacks the strata itself, so the figure has to grow with the
# number of strata. The value is used as the fig.height of the next chunk.
n_strata_plot <- if ("in_stratum" %in% names(samp$data))
    nlevels(as.factor(samp$data$in_stratum)) else 1
cov_fig_h <- if (n_strata_plot <= 3) {
    4.4 * max(1, n_strata_plot)
} else {
    4.4 * ceiling(n_strata_plot / 2)
}
```

```{r cov-plots, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(opts$covplots)) {
    cat("\n## Covariate distributions\n\n")
    cat("TG, VCG and POOL side by side for every balanced covariate.",
        "The VCG should track the TG, not the POOL.\n\n")
    if (multi) cat("_Shown for `VCG_1` of the", samp$n_vcg, "VCGs._\n\n")
}
```

```{r cov-plots-draw, results='asis', fig.height=cov_fig_h}
if (isTRUE(opts$covplots)) {
    for (v in samp$covariates) {
        cat("\n###", v, "\n\n")
        p <- try(eVCGsampler::plot_var(samp$cov_data %||% samp$data, what = v, group = "VCG"),
                 silent = TRUE)
        if (inherits(p, "try-error")) {
            cat("_This covariate could not be plotted._\n\n")
        } else {
            print(p)
            cat("\n\n")
        }
    }
}
```

```{r selected-data, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(opts$data)) {
    cat("\n# Selected animals\n\n")
    # Pre-filtered to VCG == 1 by the app, so this table, the on-screen table
    # and the two exports always describe the same animals.
    sel <- samp$selected
    # ID first - it is what makes this table actionable.
    keep <- intersect(c(samp$id, samp$stratum, samp$covariates, "e_weights",
                        "Times_selected", grep("^VCG_[0-9]+$", names(sel), value = TRUE)),
                      names(sel))
    sel <- sel[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    num <- vapply(sel, is.numeric, logical(1))
    sel[num] <- lapply(sel[num], function(x) signif(x, 4))
    if (multi) {
        cat("The ", nrow(sel), " animals drawn into at least one of the ", samp$n_vcg,
            " VCGs. `VCG_1` ... `VCG_", samp$n_vcg, "` mark membership in each VCG and ",
            "`Times_selected` counts the VCGs an animal is in.", sep = "")
    } else {
        cat("The ", nrow(sel), " animals that make up the VCG, with the energy weight each ",
            "one received.", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(samp$id)) {
        cat(" Use `", samp$id, "` to pull them from your source data.\n\n", sep = "")
    } else {
        cat(" No ID variable was selected, so the individual animals cannot be",
            "identified from this table.\n\n")
    }
    print(kt(sel))
}
```

# Method

The sampler minimises the **energy distance** between the selected control animals
and the treated group over the balanced covariates. Covariates are standardised
robustly before the distance is computed, so variables on different scales
contribute comparably; importance weights multiply the standardised covariates and
therefore change how strongly each one is pulled towards the TG.

The permutation test repeatedly reshuffles the group labels to build the
distribution of energy distances expected under no group difference, and compares
the observed distance against it. The test is one-sided.

## References

Schulz, A. *eVCGsampler: VCG Sampling using Energy-Based Covariate Balancing*.
R package version `r meta$pkg_version`, CRAN.
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/eVCGsampler/index.html>

Székely, G. J., & Rizzo, M. L. (2016). Energy distance.
*Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Computational Statistics*, 8(1), 27-38.

# Reproducibility

* eVCGsampler app version: `r meta$app_version`
* eVCGsampler version: `r meta$pkg_version`
* Random seed: `r samp$seed`
* Sampling mode: `r if (isTRUE(samp$multi)) paste0(samp$n_vcg, " random VCGs (multiSampler, Nsamples = ", samp$n_vcg, ")") else if (isTRUE(samp$random)) "random subset (random = TRUE)" else "best subset (random = FALSE)"`
* R version: `r paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")`
* Report generated: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`
